title: Exploratory analysis of tumor budding density in resected synchronous and metachronous colorectal liver metastases.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curves for 5-year overall survival according to tumor budding density in patients with synchronous CRLM.
context: Kaplan–Meier curves for 5-year overall survival according to tumor budding density in patients with synchronous CRLM. Figure 4 showed no statistically significant difference in 5-year overall survival between patients with synchronous colorectal liver metastases according to tumor budding density (log-rank p = 0.602).
